public class Pagination extends BaseComponent<elemental2.dom.HTMLElement, Pagination> implements Modifiers.Compact<elemental2.dom.HTMLElement, Pagination>, Modifiers.Disabled<elemental2.dom.HTMLElement, Pagination>, Modifiers.PageInsets<elemental2.dom.HTMLElement, Pagination>, Modifiers.Static<elemental2.dom.HTMLElement, Pagination>, Modifiers.Sticky<elemental2.dom.HTMLElement, Pagination>
A pagination component allows users to navigate through large content views that have been split across multiple pages.
